# DoD contract announcement fixtures

- `rss.xml`: live contracts RSS feed
  (`https://www.war.gov/DesktopModules/ArticleCS/RSS.ashx?ContentType=400&Site=945&max=10`),
  recorded 2026-11-09.
- `article_4042540.html` (Contracts for Jan. 27, 2025) and
  `article_4208884.html` (Contracts for June 6, 2025): original page HTML,
  recorded from the Internet Archive's raw (`id_`) captures dated 2026-10-02
  and 2026-10-03. war.gov returns 403 to non-browser clients, so these were
  the only way to record real page markup.
